svg.title: Hinge plan detail: the cover split at a divider, and door 1 on its packer at the tall cabinet
svg.text: door D(k-1), free edge
door D(k), opens right
swing, 110 deg
REAR (toward the wall)
FRONT (the room)
1/2 divider (12.7 mm)
5/8 (15.9 mm) door
1-15/32 (37 mm) to the front edge
cover 9 mm nominal
1/8 reveal (3.2 mm)
half-overlay plate (9 mm nominal cover, 0 mm plate) on
divider's RIGHT face -- the face inside D(k)'s own bay.
Holes 1-15/32 (37 mm) back from the front edge, 32 mm
apart in HEIGHT, so in plan they sit on top of each
other. Plate centres 1-1/2 and 8-7/8 above the divider
bottom (line C, 6-15/16, which is 2 above the door bottom).
Plate screws 12 mm MAX: the 15 mm screws in the
hinge box break through 1/2 ply.
35 mm cup, 12.5 mm deep, in the door's BACK face;
centre 7/8 (22.5 mm) in from the hinge edge,
3-1/2 from the door top and bottom
A -- at a divider: doors 2 to 6, hinged on dividers 1 to 5
door D1, opens right
TV door plane, 15-3/8 from the wall
5/8 tall right side (MDF)
1/4 gap, cabinet face to door edge
3/8 (9.5 mm) cover on the packer
5/8 packer
packer 3 wide
5/8 spruce packer, 3 wide x 11 tall (line C up to
the bay 1 end block), glued and screwed to the
tall side's outer face at the plate height; front
face on the TV door plane, so the plate holes land
13-29/32 from the wall (guide 4, "Mounting plates").
the tall right side carries on 8-7/16 past the TV
door, so no hinge on this face can land door 1:
hence the packer. Half overlay on the packer puts
the edge 1/64 right of 18-5/8; the cover screw eats that.
B -- at the tall cabinet: door 1 on its 5/8 packer
9 mm nominal cover + 1/8 reveal + 0.525 mm = the 1/2 divider, so D(k-1)'s free edge sits essentially flush with the divider's left face

as built at the shop's 64ths: divider 1 left face 48-37/64, right face 49-5/64, door 2 left edge 48-47/64 -- 11/32 (8.7 mm) of cover. The cover is 9 mm nominal, 11/32 to 23/64 as built, well inside the hinge's own cover adjustment
plan, looking down -- rear (wall) at the top, front (room) at the bottom
